summary: Factor assistant credential authority into a shared external-grant core with closed profiles; service issuance remains disabled

replay.detail: Existing custom.client.assistant.v1 claim kinds, digest lookup and legacy ChatGPT grants retain their meanings; no data migration.

schema.detail: No schema, registry digest or device pairing changes.

rules.detail: Assistant rights and disclosure consent are unchanged. The shared core refuses cross-profile active grants and token material in grant claims; the reserved service profile cannot issue credentials or inherit assistant rights.

compatibility.detail: Both assistant principals remain in one assistant profile with multiple same-profile grants allowed.

manual.detail: No operator action; service issuance stays disabled and the read-only assistant production freeze remains in force.

recovery.detail: Existing expiry, issuer-local authentication and append-only revocation remain unchanged.
